assessments.reasoning: The reacquired SAP guide PDF matches the frozen digest. Its cover and validity section establish client version 3.16 and the guide's own back-end context. Section 2.2.1.1.1 limits CDS view-entity support to SAP HANA on PDF page 12. The Use paragraph on PDF page 13 identifies DEFINE VIEW ENTITY in CDS DDL and lists existing database tables, views, and other non-abstract CDS entities as bases. This directly supports the descriptive statement within the scoped client-guide scenario.

challenge.method: Checked the client and back-end scope separately and compared the DDL statement, database requirement, and base objects with the cited subsection.
challenge.results: The guide expressly states the SAP HANA requirement and lists all three claimed bases. The cover and validity section establish the client-guide scope, which does not establish availability in AS ABAP 7.54.

limitations: The guide documents its client 3.16 scenario and the SAP HANA requirement within its own back-end scope. AS ABAP 7.54 release availability is outside the claim.
